clue.text: Part of the cover-up for first offenders

definitions.text: Part of the cover-up for first offenders

parts.words: Part of the cover-up for first offenders
parts.note: the first offenders are Adam and Eve in Genesis, who covered themselves with leaves after eating the forbidden fruit

explanation.surface: A criminal scandal in which the earliest culprits tried to hush things up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cover-up' suggests hushing up a crime, but here it is literal clothing, and the 'first offenders' are Adam and Eve.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis, Adam and Eve sewed leaves of this tree into garments to hide their nakedness.

clue.text: Enthuse over plant's brilliant display

indicators.note: over in a down clue means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: to fire someone is to enthuse or inspire them
a plant is a factory or works

explanation.surface: Getting excited about a factory's dazzling show.
explanation.definitionFit: Pyrotechnics make a spectacular show of light and colour in the sky.

clue.text: Shade wild animals found around marsh

indicators.note: found around says the animals word surrounds the marsh word

parts.note: game is wild animals hunted for sport
a bog is a marsh

explanation.surface: Wild creatures turned up near a swamp.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep yellow pigment made from a tree resin, a colour or tint.

clue.text: Hurried departure from work in fire, perhaps

indicators.note: in places the work inside the fire word

parts.note: fire is one of the four classical elements
op, short for opus, is a work

explanation.surface: Fleeing a workplace blaze.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fire, perhaps' points to the classical elements earth, air, fire and water.
explanation.definitionFit: Running away secretly to marry is a hasty, clandestine departure.

clue.text: Duke's handwriting

definitions.meaning: read as duke is: dukes is slang for ..., from rhyming slang Duke of Yorks for forks, meaning hands
a person's handwriting is jocularly called their ...

explanation.surface: Asking about an aristocrat's penmanship.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is'. 'Dukes' for fists comes from Cockney rhyming slang.
explanation.definitionFit: A clenched hand is a duke in slang, and the word also means one's style of script.

clue.text: Bishop introduces appropriate doctrine in early service

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
appropriate means apt
an ism is a doctrine or belief system

explanation.surface: A bishop brings in a fitting creed at a dawn church service.
explanation.definitionFit: Christening is a church service held early in life, usually for an infant.

clue.text: Onshore establishments in Omaha and Utah, for example

definitions.text: Onshore establishments in Omaha and Utah, for example

parts.words: Onshore establishments in Omaha and Utah, for example
parts.note: Omaha and Utah were code names of Normandy landing beaches in 1944, where troops set up footholds

explanation.surface: Seaside businesses in two American states.
explanation.walkthrough: Omaha and Utah look like the US city and state, but they were D-Day landing beaches.
explanation.definitionFit: Footholds captured by landing troops on a hostile shore are the bases from which an invasion spreads.

clue.text: Popular and universal ingredients in very soft cheesecake

indicators.note: ingredients in means these pieces go inside the very soft piece

parts.note: pp, pianissimo, is the musical mark for very soft
in means popular, fashionable
U is the film certificate for universal

explanation.surface: Popular and common components of a light, airy cheesecake recipe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cheesecake' is not the dessert but slang for glamour photos of women.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheesecake is slang for glamour photographs, like a picture pinned on a wall.

clue.text: Unlettered, but not ill-equipped to speak repeatedly

indicators.note: but not says the following letters are dropped from the unlettered word

parts.note: unlettered means unable to read, illiterate
taken as written

explanation.surface: Uneducated but not lacking the means to keep talking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'but not ill' removes ILL from ILLITERATE; 'equipped to' only links the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To say or do something over and over again is to repeat it.

clue.text: Employed to shore up motorway, it is thought

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting piece sits beneath, so the employed word goes below the motorway

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for motorway, as in the M1
employed means used

explanation.surface: Used to prop up a motorway, so people believe.
explanation.definitionFit: To ponder or reflect is to think something over.

clue.text: Romantic youth in Italian city finding love

parts.note: Rome is the Italian capital
love is zero in tennis, written O

explanation.surface: A young man in an Italian city finds romance.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's young lover in Verona became the byword for any amorous youth.

clue.text: Impeccable advice to heavy handed dyer?

definitions.meaning: impeccable means spotless, without a mark or fault
someone who overdoes the dye would be told to colour things less, read as two words

explanation.surface: Flawless guidance for a clumsy fabric dyer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something without blemish or moral fault is spotless, as steel that will not rust or mark.

clue.text: Inflexible court of French Revolution, ultimately

parts.note: to court someone is to woo them
de is French for of

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word Revolution

explanation.surface: An unbending tribunal of the French Revolution, in the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Court of French Revolution' suggests a revolutionary tribunal, but court is a verb for woo.
explanation.definitionFit: Stiff and rigid, as a block of timber, so lacking flexibility.

clue.text: Switch leading cards to get controlling position

indicators.note: leading means the switch piece comes in front of the cards piece

parts.note: a switch is a thin cane or whip
a hand is the set of cards a player holds

explanation.surface: Swapping the top cards to gain the upper hand in a game.
explanation.definitionFit: Holding the whip gave a coachman command, so this phrase means a position of advantage or control.

clue.text: Legitimate reason for entertainment centre

parts.note: fair means just or legitimate
a ground is a reason for something

explanation.surface: A just motive for a place of amusement.
explanation.definitionFit: An open space with rides and stalls is a place of popular amusement.

clue.text: About to appear before first lady magistrate

parts.note: re means about or concerning
Eve was the first woman in Genesis

explanation.surface: The president's wife steps out before a local justice.
explanation.definitionFit: A reeve was an English local official, in some uses a chief magistrate of a town or district.

clue.text: Pieces in redesigned tandem that could improve motion

indicators.note: in says the pieces sit inside the rearranged bicycle word
redesigned says the letters of tandem are rebuilt in a new order

parts.note: chessmen and draughtsmen are pieces, so men

explanation.surface: Parts of a remodelled two-seater bicycle that might make it ride better.
explanation.walkthrough: 'redesigned' gives AMENDT, which 'in' opens after its fifth letter. 'Motion' is a proposal put to a meeting, not movement.
explanation.definitionFit: A change proposed to a formal proposal at a meeting is meant to improve its wording.

clue.text: Painter changed red coat to yellow

indicators.note: changed signals that the letters of red coat are reordered

parts.note: or is gold or yellow in heraldry

explanation.surface: An artist switched a red jacket to a yellow one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changed' rearranges RED COAT into DECORAT. 'Painter' is a house painter, not an artist.
explanation.definitionFit: A tradesman who paints and papers houses is a painter.

clue.text: Squeeze together in quarters and manage after rent goes up

indicators.note: after places the manage word behind the turned rent word
goes up in a down clue means the rent word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to let is to rent out
E and S, east and south, are compass quarters
to cope is to manage

explanation.surface: Crammed into lodgings and coping after the rent rises.
explanation.definitionFit: To collapse in sections like a spyglass is to compress or shorten.

clue.text: Having windows covered, say, in building

definitions.text: Having windows covered, say, in building

parts.words: Having windows covered, say, in building
parts.note: describes a building whose windows are closed off with hinged panels, as when a shop is closed up

explanation.surface: A building with its windows boarded up.
explanation.definitionFit: Hinged panels closed over windows leave them covered and the house shut up.

clue.text: University professors, discontented, press for a rise

indicators.note: discontented means the word professors loses its contents, leaving its first and last letters

parts.note: to press someone is to urge them

explanation.surface: Unhappy academics press for a pay rise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'discontented' looks like unhappy, but it empties professors to P and S.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden increase or surge is a rise.

clue.text: It produces lustre in many a gem

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, so many
an opal is a gemstone

explanation.surface: Something that brings out the shine in lots of a precious stone.
explanation.definitionFit: This tropical tree resin is used in varnishes that give a glossy finish.

clue.text: River Board makes it fit to drink

parts.note: the Po is a river in Italy
a table is a board

explanation.surface: The river authority declares the water drinkable.
explanation.definitionFit: Water safe for drinking is described by this formal word.

clue.text: Its message may refer to the view of the other side

definitions.text: Its message may refer to the view of the other side

parts.words: Its message may refer to the view of the other side
parts.note: a holiday card has a picture on one face and the written note on the back often mentions that scene

explanation.surface: A message that comments on the opinion of one's opponents.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The other side' suggests an opposing faction, but it is literally the reverse face of a card bearing a picture.
explanation.definitionFit: A holiday card shows a scene on its front, and the sender's note on the back often refers to it.

clue.text: Advertisements showing shortage of inspiration?

definitions.meaning: inspiration is breathing in, so short breaths, as when one is winded

explanation.surface: Adverts that betray a lack of creative ideas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Inspiration' is taken literally, as drawing breath.
explanation.definitionFit: Short gasping breaths show a lack of breath, and the word also means puffery in promotion.

clue.text: Primate essential to church improvements

indicators.note: essential to says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A senior bishop is vital to the refurbishment of a church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Primate' suggests an archbishop, which suits the church surface, but it is the ape.
explanation.definitionFit: This African ape is a member of the primate order.

clue.text: Instrument with note echoing freely

indicators.note: an echo sends sound back, so the instrument and note are read backwards

parts.note: a sitar is an Indian stringed instrument
G is a musical note

explanation.surface: An instrument and a note ringing out without restraint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'echoing' turns the whole run of instrument plus note backwards, giving GRATIS.
explanation.definitionFit: Something given for nothing is provided free of charge.

clue.text: Simple little fellow

definitions.meaning: a simple is an old word for a medicinal plant
short form of Herbert, a man's name

explanation.surface: An uncomplicated small man.
explanation.definitionFit: A simple was a single-ingredient medicinal plant, and Herbert's pet name is a short male name.

clue.text: Equipment in good shape to carry vessel to river

indicators.note: to carry means the fit piece holds the vessel inside it

parts.note: someone in good shape is fit
an urn is a vessel
the Ure is a river in Yorkshire, England

explanation.surface: Kit in good condition for taking a container down to the river.
explanation.walkthrough: The URE is a river in North Yorkshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Tables, chairs and fittings are the movable equipment of a room.

clue.text: Cricketer returning, a couple of ducks is unacceptable

indicators.note: returning says the cricketer word goes back the other way

parts.note: a bat is a batsman, a cricketer
a duck is a score of zero in cricket, so two ducks are two Os

explanation.surface: A batsman back in the pavilion after two noughts is beyond the pale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns BAT into TAB. In cricket a duck is a batsman out for no runs.
explanation.definitionFit: Something forbidden by custom is not allowed or accepted.

clue.text: Thoroughly soaked from exercises in bay, perhaps

indicators.note: in places the exercises inside the horse word

parts.note: a bay is a reddish-brown horse, an example of a steed
PE is physical education, exercises

explanation.surface: Drenched after workouts out in the bay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bay' suggests the sea, but it is a horse of that colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Left to soak long in liquid, so saturated through.

clue.text: Karen's kind of cat

definitions.meaning: the Karen are a people of Myanmar, formerly Burma, so a Karen's nationality
a breed of short-haired domestic cat from south-east Asia

explanation.surface: Asking what breed a woman named Karen keeps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Karen' looks like a woman's name, but the Karen are an ethnic group of Burma.
explanation.definitionFit: The Karen people live in Myanmar, and one cat breed takes its name from that country.
